title: primula latifolia subsp. graveolens
intro: Primula latifolia subsp. graveolens, commonly known as Graveolent Primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Primula latifolia subsp. graveolens include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
